title: Geometry-Dependent Equilibria in Generalized Lennard-Jones-Type Power-Law Systems
description: A review-corrected reproducible theoretical and computational study of geometry-dependent constrained radial equilibria in a generalized inverse-power force model. v0.1.2 (publication candidate) scopes the analytic large-N zeta limit to n>m>2, scan-qualifies the N=4 polygon minimum, fixes source-index propagation, and removes build artifacts; v0.1.1 added an analytic large-N zeta limit, a co-spherical geometry bound, full-vector residual checks for cuboids, an exact normalization-rescaling identity, deterministic builders for all data/figures, and clarified provenance. Mixed licensing: code under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; manuscript/figures/documentation under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
